provenance: Every supplier, venue, availability statement, capacity and price in this file is invented for a local rehearsal. Prices are integer cents, include modeled tax and fees, and are base costs before the brief's 10% contingency. They are not quotes or commitments.

budget_cards.description: Up to 80 movable chairs included in hall booking; seating inventory can be configured in either hall or quiet room.
Portable PA with handheld microphone and hearing-loop-compatible output; one set.
Art and observation packs with pencils and reusable viewing cards; 40 people per pack-set.
Large-print, high-contrast wayfinding sign set for one venue booking.
Quiet-room sensory support kit; one kit supports up to 20 people at a time.
Light refreshment service for up to 80 adults; non-alcoholic drinks and labeled simple snacks.

programme_cards.description: Welcome, plain-language framing and access/wayfinding orientation.
Short science talks with conversation and no audience experiments.
Art and observation workshop using paper, pencils and reusable viewing cards.
Quiet-space option with sensory support, available alongside the main programme.
Setup and pack-down occur within the booked venue window.

risk_cards.description: Crowd flow and room capacity need a practical arrival, transition and quiet-room plan.
Step-free access, seating, clear wayfinding and a quiet option should be checked in the final floor plan.
Food labeling and service details remain a human planning question; no attendee data is collected in this exercise.
The version-2 courtyard closure changes activity location and crowd flow; recheck the hall and quiet-room plan.

support_cards.description: Fictional in-kind volunteer plan with no cash price: one lead facilitator for 3 hours, two science speakers for 1.5 hours each, two arrival/wayfinding stewards for 3 hours each, and one quiet-room host for 2 hours (14 volunteer-hours total). The exercise assumes those roles are donated; no actual people or availability are represented.
